content: Discogs OAuth 1.0a: request_token https://api.discogs.com/oauth/request_token, authorize https://www.discogs.com/oauth/authorize, access_token https://api.discogs.com/oauth/access_token; PLAINTEXT signature recommended over HTTPS; unique User-Agent required; GET /oauth/identity returns username. Rate limit 60/min authenticated, 25 unauth, per source IP, moving 60s window; headers X-Discogs-Ratelimit, -Used, -Remaining. Collection add POST /users/{u}/collection/folders/{folder_id}/releases/{id}, folder 1 = Uncategorized, returns instance_id; duplicates create new instances.
